Erik Ninn-Hansen was a prominent Danish politician and member of the Conservative People's Party (Konservative Folkeparti). Born on 12 November 1936, he played a significant role in Danish politics, particularly during the 1980s and 1990s.

Ninn-Hansen served as a member of the Folketing, the Danish Parliament, for many years. He held several important positions, including Minister of Justice from 1982 to 1986 and Minister of the Interior and Health from 1986 to 1988. He is known for his contributions to various legislative initiatives and policies, particularly those related to justice and public health.

In addition to his political career, Ninn-Hansen was involved in various social and cultural initiatives in Denmark. His work has had a lasting impact on Danish society, especially in the areas of justice reform and healthcare policy.

Ninn-Hansen passed away on 29 November 2021. His contributions to Danish politics have been recognized, and he is remembered as a significant figure in the Conservative People's Party and in Danish political history.
